title: 第210章 荒原鏖退魔骑锋寒夜营悬覆渊机第209章 破尽重关临渊野遥瞻魔垒决峥嵘
content_zh:
第210章荒原鏖退魔骑锋，寒夜营悬覆渊机
蔡文姬指尖轻点舆图，快速规划进军方略：
“大军分三路齐头并进，互为犄角，防止被魔骑分割包围。”
“左路：铠、韩信率领上古战魂军，作为先锋步兵阵线，抵挡正面魔军冲击。”
“右路：黄忠炮队搭配伽罗、百里守约，占据荒原零星高地，远程持续压制魔骑。”
“中路主力由我、嫦娥、杨玉环坐镇，西施、大乔掌控水系力量，随时支援左右两翼。”
“妲己带领轻骑游走侧翼，侦查敌情、扰乱敌军阵型，梦奇在空中巡游，吞噬飘荡魔气与负面怨魂。”
“扁鹊医帐紧跟中路，随时接应各路伤员。”
“切记，荒原开阔，魔骑机动性极强，切忌孤军冒进！一旦遭遇大规模魔骑冲锋，立刻收拢阵型，构筑防御阵地。”
军令层层传递，三日休整期满。
清晨号角响彻断云隘，联军一万五千将士整齐列阵，旗帜迎风烈烈作响。
“拔营，进军断魂渊荒原！”
蔡文姬一声令下，三路大军依次踏出隘口，踏入暗紫色荒原大地。
空气中的魔气厚重粘稠，吸入肺腑便觉灵力滞涩。
嫦娥立刻催动【月魄增幅】，大范围月华光幕笼罩中路大军，银白色光芒不断净化周遭魔气，为全军撑起一片安稳区域。
行军半日，荒原北侧大地传来隆隆震动。
地平线尘土漫天飞扬，黑压压的魔骑军团策马疾驰而来，铁蹄践踏大地，震得地面微微颤抖。
战马早已魔化，双目赤红，獠牙外露，骑士身披黑铁魔甲，长枪尖端萦绕漆黑魔气。
“魔骑先锋来了！”铠纵马向前，【不灭魔躯】黑金光焰升腾，战魂军迅速结成坚固方阵，长矛层层朝外。
李靖立于魔骑阵前，玄甲肃穆。

他退守荒原之后收拢残兵，汇合魔骑主力，打算在外围率先拦截联军。
“蔡文姬，止步于此！踏入荒原深处，便是绝路，若放下兵器归降右护法，尚可保全麾下将士性命。”
蔡文姬策马来到阵前，声音清晰传遍旷野：
“右护法妄图释放魔渊本源，致使五域生灵涂炭，此路我绝不会退。李靖，你精通兵法，应当看清结局，何必继续为邪道卖命？”
李靖面色不改：“各为其主，多说无益！全军，冲锋！”
号令落下，上万魔骑策马狂奔，掀起滔天尘雾，直直冲向战魂军方阵！
【鲤跃之潮】！
大乔抬手一挥，地面裂缝涌出水流，在方阵前方凝成宽阔水沼。
高速冲锋的魔骑来不及收势，大批战马失足陷入泥潭，冲锋势头骤然受阻。
西施同步催动水丝缠绕马蹄，进一步迟滞魔骑攻势。
“放箭！”
伽罗在高地拉满长弓，漫天破魔箭倾泻而下，大批魔骑中箭坠落马下。
黄忠重炮轰鸣，炮弹落入魔骑集群，烈焰与魔气剧烈碰撞，炸开大片缺口。
魔骑冲破水系阻拦，与战魂军正面相撞。
铠长刀横扫，每一次挥击都有数名魔骑应声倒地。
韩信银枪游走于阵前，不断斩杀试图迂回穿插的魔将。
魔骑悍不畏死，依靠数量持续轮番冲击，战魂军方阵承受着巨大压力。
content_en:
Chapter 210: The Demon Cavalry is defeated in the wasteland, and the cold night camp is overturned.
Cai Wenji tapped the map with her fingertips and quickly planned an entry strategy:
"The army is divided into three groups and marches together, acting as horns for each other to prevent being divided and surrounded by the demon knights."
"Left: Kai and Han Xin lead the ancient war spirit army as the vanguard infantry front to resist the frontal attack of the demon army."
"On the right: Huang Zhong Artillery Team, together with Jia Luo and Baili Shou, occupy scattered highlands in the wasteland and continue to suppress the Demon Cavalry from a distance."
"The main force in the middle is controlled by me, Chang'e, and Yang Yuhuan. Xi Shi and Da Qiao control the water system and can support the left and right wings at any time."
"Daji led the Qingqi to roam the flanks, scouting the enemy's situation and disrupting the enemy's formation. Mengqi cruised in the air, devouring the floating demonic energy and negative resentful souls."
"Bian Que's medical tent follows the middle road closely and is ready to respond to the wounded from all walks of life."
"Remember, the wilderness is wide and the demon cavalry is extremely mobile. Do not rush forward alone! Once you encounter a large-scale demon cavalry charge, immediately close your formation and build a defensive position."
Military orders were passed from level to level, and the three-day rest period expired.
In the early morning, the horn sounded through Duanyun Pass, and the 15,000 soldiers of the coalition army lined up in order, and the flags sounded fiercely in the wind.
"Bring up camp and march into the Soul-Desolating Abyss Wasteland!"
Cai Wenji gave an order, and the three armies stepped out of the pass one after another and entered the dark purple wasteland.
The demonic energy in the air is thick and viscous, and when you breathe it into your lungs, you will feel that your spiritual power is stagnant.
Chang'e immediately activated [Moon Soul Amplification], and a large moonlight curtain enveloped the army in the middle. The silver-white light continuously purified the surrounding demonic energy, creating a stable area for the entire army.
After marching for half a day, the ground on the north side of the wasteland rumbled and shook.
Dust was flying all over the horizon, and the black army of demon cavalry galloped towards them. Their iron hooves trampled the earth, causing the ground to tremble slightly.
The war horse has long been demonized, with red eyes and fangs exposed. The knight is wearing black iron magic armor, and the tip of the spear is filled with dark demonic energy.
"The Demon Cavalry Vanguard is coming!" Kai rode his horse forward, [Immortal Demonic Body] black gold flames rose, and the war spirit army quickly formed a solid square formation, with their spears pointing outwards.
Li Jing stood in front of the demon cavalry formation, his black armor solemn.
After retreating to the wasteland, he gathered the remaining soldiers and joined the main force of the Demon Cavalry, intending to take the lead in intercepting the coalition forces on the periphery.
"Cai Wenji, stop here! Stepping into the depths of the wilderness is a dead end. If you put down your weapons and surrender to the Right Protector, you can still save the lives of your soldiers."
Cai Wenji rode her horse to the front of the formation, and her voice clearly spread across the wilderness:
"The right protector is trying to release the source of the devil, which has caused the destruction of all living beings in the five realms. I will never retreat from this path. Li Jing, you are proficient in the art of war and should see the outcome clearly. Why continue to work for the evil way?"
Li Jing's expression did not change: "Each one has his own master, it's useless to talk more! All troops, charge!"
After the order was given, tens of thousands of demonic knights galloped on their horses, setting off huge dust and mist, and rushed straight towards the Battle Soul Army formation!
【The Tide of Carp Jump】!
Da Qiao raised his hand and water flowed out of the cracks in the ground, forming a wide swamp in front of the phalanx.
The high-speed charging demon cavalry had no time to stop its momentum. A large number of war horses lost their footing and fell into the quagmire, and the momentum of the charge was suddenly hindered.
Xi Shi simultaneously activated the water threads to wrap around the horse's hooves, further delaying the demon cavalry's offensive.
"Fire the arrow!"
Jialuo drew his long bow on the high ground, and the demon-breaking arrows poured down from the sky. A large number of demon cavalry were hit by arrows and fell off their horses.
Huang Zhong's heavy artillery roared, and the shells fell into the group of demon cavalry. The flames and demonic energy collided violently, exploding a large gap.
The Demon Cavalry broke through the water system obstruction and collided head-on with the War Soul Army.
The armored sword swept across, and with each swing, several demon knights fell to the ground.
Han Xin's silver spear roamed in front of the formation, constantly killing the demon generals who tried to weave around.
The Demon Cavalry was fearless and fearless, relying on their numbers to continuously attack in turn, putting the Battle Spirit Army formation under tremendous pressure.
